title: COA flags just 2% completion of 5,298 target classrooms in 2025

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has flagged the low percentage of completed classrooms for 2025, noting that only 2 percent of the 5,298 classrooms targeted to be built that year were actually finished. According to its 2025 audit report on the Department of Education (DepEd), COA said 66 percent, or 9,450 out of 14,267 classrooms funded from 2021 to 2025, have yet to be constructed. The majority of these unconstructed classrooms can be attributed to the 2025 targets, during which only 99 out of 5,298, or 2 percent, were actually built, COA noted.
